title: Bing Wallpaper showing Ad for Harry Potter and Fantastic beasts box set
excerpt: I have been using Bing Wallpaper happily for years. Today, for the first time I noticed a hecking ad in place of my wallpaper. Why this level of nickel and diming. This is atrocious UX, its ad over entire screen, For a moment I thought I installed some adware malware.
content_html:
I have been using Bing Wallpaper happily for years. Today, for the first time I noticed a hecking ad in place of my wallpaper.

Why this level of nickel and diming. This is atrocious UX, its ad over entire screen, For a moment I thought I installed some adware malware.
